subject: Schedule reset and MAP exception request — FinCo evaluation
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Reed <j.reed@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Hi Rishi,

Quick update from our side: procurement asked us to pause signing until the legal team confirms a data residency clause — looks like that will take ~2 weeks. That pushes our originally targeted pilot start (June 7) out.

We still want to run the evaluation and would like to avoid slipping the close if possible. Can you share what parts of the MAP can proceed without PO in-place (e.g., sandbox access, eval dataset prep)? Also, can Redwood provide a short risk log for our executive review that explains mitigation options?

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility here.

Olivia
Olivia Grant
Head of ML Ops, FinCo
[attachment: none]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finco.com>
Cc: Jacob Reed <j.reed@finco.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Olivia — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: we can parallelize several MAP tasks that do not require a PO or production keys. Proposed immediate steps:

- Sandbox access (demo cluster) can be provisioned under an NDA-only flow within 48–72 hours.
- Eval dataset ingest (we can provide templates and a staging S3 presigned flow) — data ingestion and anonymization can be completed before procurement finalization.
- Initial quality gates (prompt sets + eval harness) can be run on smaller-scale samples to validate signal.

I attached a draft MAP with adjusted milestones and a one-page risk log so you have something for your execs. If procurement requires residency language, we can propose a limited pilot with all logs forwarded to a region-specific S3 bucket and a contractual fallback; that will take a short redline but is doable.

Next steps I recommend:
1) FinCo confirms which teams will run evals and their preferred sandbox dates.
2) We agree which MAP milestones can be considered "no-PO" tasks.
3) If you want, we can set a 30-minute sync tomorrow to align.

Attachments: FinCo_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), [risk log: short form embedded in MAP].

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
[attachment: FinCo_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Rishi / team — looping in a brief risk note for tracking and for SaaS ops input. High-level items for the risk log:

- Risk: Procurement stall (2+ week delay) -> Impact: Pilot start slips, potential Q2 conversion risk (~$120k revenue timing).
- Mitigation 1: NDA + sandbox provisioning (low effort).
- Mitigation 2: Offer a one-month credit window on usage once PO is signed if the delay exceeds 14 days (requires sales leadership approval).
- Mitigation 3: Escalate to account exec/leadership if procurement asks for non-standard legal language (privacy/residency) — we can offer a scoped technical workaround.

Asks: Rishi, please document what you need from FinCo to execute the sandbox (contacts, dataset owners, sample files). Also, if we pursue the credit window, I need a note describing expected revenue impact and approval request.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[attachment: none]

From: Jacob Reed <j.reed@finco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finco.com>
Cc: FinCo Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Rishi,

Thanks — procurement confirmed they need the residency line in the SOW before finance can sign. They attached a short summary of our PO constraints (see attached). We are open to doing the sandbox under NDA, but procurement insists on a hard date for pilot kickoff for internal tracking — otherwise they won't prioritize the legal review.

If Redwood can commit to the reset plan and provide a one-page risk mitigation note we can show our CFO, that would help us keep the internal timeline even with the legal queue.

Attachment: PO_Term_Summary.pdf

— Jacob

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finco.com>, Jacob Reed <j.reed@finco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Jacob / Olivia — appreciate the clarity. Attached is an updated evaluation plan that compresses the MAP where possible and proposes a re-baselined schedule that preserves a mid-June pilot window while procurement completes the SOW redline. Key points:

- Parallelize dataset ingest + model calibration tasks (team A / team B split) so evaluation runtime does not depend on PO issuance.
- Target pilot kickoff: June 14 (2-week shift) with contingency checkpoints on June 7 and June 11.
- If procurement signs by June 7, we can revert to the original June 7 kickoff and fast-track provisioning.
- We can provide a one-page executive risk summary and a temporary SLA exception form for audit purposes (need leadership sign-off).

Ask from FinCo: confirm sandbox point-of-contact and sample dataset by EOD Wednesday (May 27). If you can approve the temporary timeline, we'll issue an updated MAP and schedule a short triage call for June 1 to align owners.

Attachments: FinCo_EvalPlan_v2.docx (proposed compressed plan), [exec_risk_summary: embedded].

— Rishi
[attachment: FinCo_EvalPlan_v2.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — potential procurement delay

Team — escalating for leadership approval:

Summary: FinCo procurement needs residency language; they are willing to run a sandbox under NDA. Rishi has proposed a compressed eval plan with a two-week push to June 14 that preserves momentum. Revenue timing risk if this slips further (~$120k Q2).

Requested approvals:
- Approve one-month credit window option if legal review extends beyond June 7 (we'd offer a usage credit applied on invoice).
- Approve temporary SLA exception form and sign-off flow for the sandbox (security will track post-procurement).

Supporting docs attached in thread. If leadership signs off on credits and exception, we can keep FinCo engaged and avoid pipeline decay.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
